_comment: Geography table for listing views + the wage block (batch 3). CONFIG, NOT CODE: a market/state/city is a ROW here, never an `if` in an adapter or the bake. Market stays a PARAMETER (noprobjobs/data/routes.js MARKET); a second state (e.g. Texas) is added by APPENDING rows (one kind:state + its kind:city rows) with no code change. Each city inherits its state's wage rate unless it has a local ordinance (wage.rule). Rates carry effective dates + a source URL; the wage block NEVER displays a figure not in this table. min_jobs = the CITY-ONLY NONE_NEEDED primary count a listing view must reach to publish (batch 3 TASK 2); nearby jobs never count toward it. nearby_radius_miles + nearby_sort govern the 'More Jobs Nearby' feed below the separator.

_wage_sources.verified: 2026-10-01 — WA state 2026 $17.13 (eff Jan 1). 2027 rates INTENTIONALLY OMITTED per directive (L&I lists state $17.73 eff 2027-01-01; add once owner-confirmed). L&I local page: Seattle $21.30; Everett tiered; Renton tiered (Jul 1 step); Tukwila $21.65 (15+ ww + conditions); SeaTac $20.74 HOSPITALITY/TRANSPORTATION ONLY (general jobs follow state). Auburn/Kent/Spokane Valley/Spokane/Tacoma/Bellevue not listed -> inherit state. Spokane added 2026-10-01 (owner reversed the hold — 109 jobs / 72 NONE_NEEDED). Redmond/Lynnwood/Bothell/Vancouver/Yakima NOT built (owner).

wage.note: Tiered by employer size; 14-or-fewer-employee employers are not covered and follow the WA state rate. Render as a range 'depending on employer size', never a single tier.
